Digital Experience Showcase

Move your content between platforms without losing a single field.

DXS is a working test bed for CMS migrations. Real content models, relationships, rich text and assets, ready to compare before and after every move.

Explore the showcase
View the design system

Everything a migration needs to prove itself

23 routes, all seeded

From blog and products to events, careers and the admin CMS, every route resolves real records with stable identifiers.

Relationships stay intact

Authors link to posts, products to reviews, events to speakers. Check reference integrity after every move.

Every publication state

Published, draft, scheduled and archived entries, plus null fields, Unicode text and long bodies.

Works offline

Mock mode needs no database and no network. Seed and reset to the same fixed fixtures any time.

items.title: Additional
items.body:
Migration integrity rules (highest priority):
- Content must stay exportable through the standard WordPress export (WXR). Prefer core blocks and standard patterns; avoid exotic blocks whose markup or data will not survive an export.
- Do not rename, retitle, or delete existing fixture posts, pages, categories, or tags once created — migrations and their verification compare against them. Add new fixtures instead of editing old ones, unless explicitly instructed.
- Keep page hierarchy and taxonomy hierarchy intact (for example, the child page under "About This Testbed" and the child category under "Field Notes").

Family links to keep wherever links are listed (footer, About page): migrateme.tech, lovable.sandbox.migrateme.tech, lovable.cloud.sandbox.migrateme.tech.

Accessibility: one H1 per page, headings in order, meaningful link text (never "click here"), sufficient color contrast — the burnt-orange accent is for large text, stats, and graphic accents, not small body text.

Content that should never appear on this site: real personal data; real customer or patient information; prices or purchase calls to action; placeholder lorem ipsum; the default WordPress sample text ("123 Example Street", "hi@example.com") anywhere visible.
items.author: mdemop

items.title: Copy
items.body:
Voice: editorial field notes. Plain, precise, concrete; short sentences; active voice. Write like an engineer keeping a public lab notebook, not like a marketer. Headings in sentence case. Section eyebrows may use the family's uppercase label style (for example "FIELD NOTES" or "FROM THE TESTBED").

Terminology: posts are "field notes"; seeded content items are "fixtures"; the site is "the testbed". The project is "migrateme.tech" (lowercase, with the dot) on first reference per page.

Fixture discipline (this is the site's purpose — never break it):
- Publication states are deliberate test fixtures: published, draft, private, and scheduled posts all exist on purpose. A title that declares a state ("Draft: ...", "Private: ...", "Scheduled: ...") must always match the post's actual status.
- Scheduled content uses the site timezone, America/Chicago; when a time matters, state the timezone.
- People are fixtures too: use only the established fake identities with @example.com addresses. Never invent real-seeming people, and never publish real personal data.
- Statistics must be true counts of this site's own content. Do not copy the app editions' numbers (22 content models, 23 route patterns) onto this site; the WordPress edition reports its own counts.

Never invent for this edition: products, prices, events, testimonials, customers, or metrics. Commerce, events, and testimonial content belong to the app editions of DXS. If a section needs an example, use the site's real fixtures (posts, pages, categories, comments) or say plainly that the WordPress edition does not include it.

items.title: Site
items.body:
# DXS — WordPress Edition (wp.sandbox.migrateme.tech)

This site is the WordPress edition of DXS (Digital Experience Showcase), a CMS/SaaS migration test bed for migrateme.tech. It is a real WordPress site whose job is to be migrated: its content exists so a migration engine can be verified end to end — record counts, field values, reference integrity, publication state, ordering, and rich-text rendering — against an honest WordPress export (WXR).

Provenance: DXS is based on a canonical brief and content contracts that originate from a prompt by Microsoft Copilot Cowork. Preserve this attribution wherever the test bed is described.

The DXS family:
- This site (WordPress edition): wp.sandbox.migrateme.tech
- App edition (mock data layer): lovable.sandbox.migrateme.tech
- App edition (Supabase data layer): lovable.cloud.sandbox.migrateme.tech
- Parent project: migrateme.tech (open-source, AI-assisted CMS migration toolkit)

Primary audience: migration engineers, the migrateme.tech project, and reviewers evaluating migration quality. This is a testbed, not a business: it has no real customers, sells nothing, and books nothing. Never present it as a commercial site.

items.body:
This post exists to be migrated. It carries the structures real WordPress content accumulates: headings, lists, a pull quote, an inline image, and links.

What a dry run should catch

  • Broken internal links
  • Missing featured images
  • Fields with no destination home

Never migrate on a Friday. Never migrate without a dry run.

See the migrateme.tech project for the toolkit that consumes this export.

items.title: Images
items.body:
Visual identity (match the DXS app editions): warm cream/ivory background (#FBF9F3), dark warm-ink tones (#1F1B16), and a single burnt-orange accent (#D9431F). Editorial, magazine-like, understated.

- Prefer flat, diagrammatic graphics and honest screenshots over photography; if photography is used, it must look unstaged and documentary, never glossy stock.
- Avoid: purple/blue gradient startup art, glassmorphism, generic AI-gloss illustrations, and stock-photo handshakes.
- Every image must have descriptive alt text under 125 characters.
- Prefer images uploaded to this site's media library over hotlinked external images: exports must carry their own media.
- Landscape orientation for hero and header images.

items.body:
Digital Experience Showcase · WordPress Edition

A real WordPress site, built to be migrated.

This is the WordPress edition of DXS, the content test bed for migrateme.tech — a live WordPress site seeded with posts, pages, taxonomy, and comments across every publication state, so a CMS migration can be verified end to end instead of eyeballed.

Read the field notes

8 POSTS

total field notes

4 PUBLICATION STATES

published · draft · private · scheduled

2 HIERARCHY LEVELS

pages and categories

Latest field notes

About this testbed

DXS (Digital Experience Showcase) is an open content test bed built for migrateme.tech — an AI-assisted CMS migration toolkit. This WordPress edition is one of three: the app editions live at lovable.sandbox.migrateme.tech and lovable.cloud.sandbox.migrateme.tech. All three share the same content contract so a migration engine can be cross-verified across platforms.

This site is seeded with real publication states, taxonomy hierarchies, and comment threads — not lorem ipsum. Read more about the testbed, or review the methodology and fixtures.
